# LinkedScore

> LinkedScore (https://www.linkedscore.app) is an AI LinkedIn analyzer. You upload your LinkedIn profile as a PDF, answer a short quiz and optionally add post screenshots, and it returns a free LinkedIn Score (0-100) with a personalized growth plan: profile rewrites, keyword analysis, an SSI breakdown, ready-to-edit post hooks and a 30-day roadmap. Built by Ali Azad. Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch and Italian.

Key facts:
- The LinkedIn Score is a 0-100 read of a real profile, not a quiz-only estimate; uploading the profile PDF produces the anchored score.
- The report includes a Thought Leader Score when post screenshots are provided, and an SSI (Social Selling Index) pillar analysis when the user enters their four SSI pillar values.
- A Post Writer turns a rough draft into a LinkedIn post in the user's own voice; signed-in users' saved tone is reused automatically.
- The free report can be followed by a paid 1:1 strategy session.
